mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(total_amount) AS orderAmount FROM `order` WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS today_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= CURDATE() AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.create_time < CURDATE() AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_sales_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS pending_payment_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS pending_delivery_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS shipped_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS completed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 END) AS month_order_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) THEN 1 END) AS week_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS month_sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week_sales_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM return_apply WHERE status = 0) AS pending_return_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS total_product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND publish_status = 1) AS published_product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (publish_status = 0 OR publish_status IS NULL)) AS unpublished_product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(stock, 0) <= 10) AS low_stock_product_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user) AS total_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE create_time >= CURDATE()) AS today_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND create_time < CURDATE()) AS yesterday_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')) AS month_user_count FROM `order` o
